tldr: A fixed planned cohort with public staggered entry and delayed binary events has a cumulative HT error generated by balanced assignment signs appearing twice in a fixed potential-event order. Every legal word remains realizable, including in the all-at-zero subclass, so the exact schedule-uniform frontier is the all-word quantity \(C_N\). The delivered calibration result is the sharp schedule-uniform leading limit, twice the absolute Brownian-bridge maximum, together with proved supporting finite-rate brackets. Two finite questions remain explicit residuals: \texttt{oeq:global-compression} asks for an all-word structural reduction and certified exact algorithm, while \texttt{oeq:finite-bridge-rate} asks for the sharp quantitative approximation and induced integer quantile correction. The motivating OOM count question follows \cite{LindonKallus2026}, Section 6, with a prospective balanced complete-randomization design.
